purpose: Navigate already cached cursor pages and request only the next opaque-cursor page without inventing a total.

pageChange.description: Moves to a previously loaded page without a network request.

fetchNextPage.description: Requests the next page through the owning query adapter.

accessibility.keyboard: Previous and next actions are native buttons with deterministic disabled states.
accessibility.focus: Cached-page navigation keeps focus on the invoked control.
accessibility.screenReader: Current loaded page, busy state, item counts and repeated-cursor stop are announced.

invariants: The component never derives or displays an unknown total page count.
Previous navigation is limited to cached pages and never performs a request.
A repeated next cursor disables fetching and its opaque value is never rendered.
